tokens.name: ink-black
tokens.usage: Core palette. Deep navy-black: primary text on light grounds, page background in dark theme.

tokens.name: hot-fuchsia
tokens.usage: Core palette. The brand's signal hue: the logo's dot, the rule under section titles, badges and failing tests. Pair with ink-black text (5.2:1); white text on it is only 3.5:1, so avoid it.

tokens.name: light-sea-green
tokens.usage: Core palette. The action and pass color: primary buttons, focus rings, ✓ marks, stat numbers. Pair with ink-black text (8.4:1); never white text (2.2:1).

tokens.name: bright-snow
tokens.usage: Core palette. Off-white: page background in light theme, primary text in dark theme.

tokens.name: blue-bell
tokens.usage: Core palette. Links; hover state of primary buttons. Pair with ink-black text (6.7:1); white text on it is 2.7:1, avoid.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page background (the site's --bg).

tokens.name: surface-alt
tokens.usage: Alternating section bands, with a border-top and border-bottom; the ground of the role switch and Inspect toggle.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, stats and chips' ground (the site's --surface).

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Code blocks in articles.

tokens.name: surface-sunken-bar
tokens.usage: The Inspect mode tooltip's ground.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Hairlines: card outlines, section edges, ghost buttons, timeline rail, the hero's dot grid (decorative, not a control boundary).

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Body and heading text on every surface token.

tokens.name: text-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text — leads, meta, labels — on surface, surface-alt and surface-raised (7.3:1 dark, 6.5:1 light).

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Primary button fill, role switch indicator, focus ring, timeline dots. Text on it is on-color.

tokens.name: primary-text
tokens.usage: Sea-green used as text: ✓ pass marks, stat numbers, the role line, company names (8.4:1 dark; the light value darkens to 4.7:1).

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Links on surface tokens (6.7:1 dark, 5.0:1 light).

tokens.name: hot
tokens.usage: Section-title rule, WIP badge, failing tests, the logo dot. A mark, not body text on light grounds (3.3:1 on bright-snow).

tokens.name: on-color
tokens.usage: Text and icons on primary, blue-bell and hot fills.

tokens.name: chip-bg
tokens.usage: Default chip ground (blue-bell at 12%), over surface-raised or surface-alt.

tokens.name: chip-text
tokens.usage: Default chip label (blue-bell mixed toward white in dark).

tokens.name: chip-test-bg
tokens.usage: Testing-stack chip ground (sea-green at 16%).

tokens.name: chip-test-text
tokens.usage: Testing-stack chip label.

families.sans: "Nunito Variable", "Nunito", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif
families.mono: "JetBrains Mono", ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

styles.name: display-hero
styles.usage: The name in the home hero. Fluid: clamp(2.8rem, 6.4vw, 5.2rem).

styles.name: h1
styles.usage: Page title on every page but the home. Fluid on the site: clamp(2.2rem, 5vw, 3.6rem).

styles.name: h2
styles.usage: Section titles, set UPPERCASE with a 3rem × 4px hot rule beneath. Fluid: clamp(1.6rem, 3vw, 2.1rem).

styles.name: stat-number
styles.usage: Stat tile numbers, in primary-text, at the end of About.

styles.name: headline
styles.usage: The role line, in primary-text: the CV header, and the hero when JavaScript is off.

styles.name: brand-name
styles.usage: The name beside the logo in the header.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Small UPPERCASE labels: the hero location, and above chip groups (Development, Testing).

styles.name: role-switch
styles.usage: Role switch labels (0.85rem up to 600px wide).

styles.name: scroll-cue
styles.usage: The UPPERCASE label of the scroll cue under the hero.

styles.name: lead
styles.usage: Intro paragraph under a section title, in text-muted.

styles.name: nav
styles.usage: Header navigation links, text-muted until hover.

styles.name: meta
styles.usage: Dates, places, stat labels, footer text — in text-muted.

styles.name: code-locator
styles.usage: The locator in the Inspect mode tooltip.

spacing.note: The rem steps the site really uses. Sections size fluidly: clamp(3rem, 7vw, 5rem) top and bottom.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gaps between chips; icon-to-label gaps are 0.5em.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Button rows (.cta-row).

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Grid gaps between cards and stats.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Space above a secondary section title (.sub).

tokens.name: container-max
tokens.usage: Page container width (the site's --maxw), with a 1.25rem side gutter.

tokens.name: prose-max
tokens.usage: Reading width (.narrow).

tokens.name: dot-pitch
tokens.usage: Spacing of the hero's dot grid, 1px dots in border.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Focus-ring corners.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Chips; inline code uses 5px.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, certification rows, code blocks, the Inspect tooltip.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, stat tiles (the site's --radius).

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Badges, the language switch, the role switch, the Inspect toggle, timeline dots.

shadow.note: The site uses a single shadow; everything else is separated by borders and surface steps.

tokens.name: shadow-float
tokens.usage: The Inspect mode tooltip: the one element that floats above the page. Don't put it on cards.
